# 🛡️ NeuralOps v1.4.1: Contributor Standards & Quality Gate

## 🌟 Highlights
- **Complete MIT Contributor Attribution**: Standardized MIT copyright headers across all 1,719 files referencing [https://github.com/tahamajs/NeuralOps/graphs/contributors](https://github.com/tahamajs/NeuralOps/graphs/contributors).
- **Strict Quality Gate**: Automated AST-based code hygiene checking for zero shadowed definitions, zero unreachable code, and zero unlaunched kernels.
- **PyPI Release**: Official distribution published on PyPI.

## 📦 Installation
```bash
pip install neuralops==1.4.1
```
